retrieval_method: ordinary requests.get, no browser or authentication
encoding: UTF-8 as explicitly declared by HTML meta; HTTP Content-Type is text/html without charset
scope: Czech Cup | Men; unfiltered stages and clubs; 141 result rows excluded, 8 named unplayed pairings
